d: Kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne kaha- 'main manta hun ki chhath parv ek aisa mahaparv jismen aastha aur samarpan hai. ismen na koee murtipuja, na ismen koee aise riti rivaj, na koee aisa puja path; yah sirph prakriti ke prati samarpan hai. main manta hun ki hamari pirhi aur agli pirhi ko is parv se sikh lene ki jarurat hai ki prakriti ke prati hamari shraddha aur aastha kaisi honi chahie? yah sadiyon pahle hamare purvajon dvara ham log ko sikhaya gaya tha. jis vakt vigyan nahin tha, taknik nahin thi; us vakt to kisi ko nahin pata tha ne ki urja ka srot sury hai. aise men aaj jab ham sury…
